#' 
#' @param x Input data
#' @param mu Mean of component
#' @param sigma Standard deviation of component
#' @param lam Mixture weight of component
plot_mix_comps <- function(x, mu, sigma, lam) {
  lam * dnorm(x, mu, sigma)
}

#filtered combined data set according to minimum synonymous LogFC and Standard Deviation###
####################LOESS curve with smoother fit ###########################
data_5g_Loess <- data_5g_13g_combined%>%filter(LogFC_5g >=	
-1.808111)
loess_15_5g <- loess(LogFC_5g ~ `cDNA..`, data = data_5g_Loess, span = 0.15)
data_5g_Loess$smoothed15 <- predict(loess_15_5g) 
y_limits <- range(c(data_5g_13g_combined$LogFC_5g, data_5g_13g_combined$LogFC_13g))

#plotting model to observe fit 
p_5g<-ggplot(data_5g_13g_combined, aes(x = `cDNA..`, y = LogFC_5g)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Mutation.type), size=2.2) + geom_line(data = data_5g_Loess, aes(x = `cDNA..`, y = smoothed15 ), color = "red", size =1.5)+  # LOESS fit
  labs(title = "       3 Day Donor 1 LOESS", x = "                                                                 gDNA position", y = "LogFC",color = "Mutation Type") +  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mis" = "#1f77b4", "Non" = "#e63f29", "Syn" = "#42bd0d")) +  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 772.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +  # Adjust vertical line style
  geom_vline(xintercept = 677.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +  # Adjust vertical line style
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # Adjust x-axis text angle
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Adjust axis text size
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5), 
     panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    aspect.ratio = .9, plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 12))
  )+
  ylim(y_limits)
caption_grob <- textGrob("LOESS span = 0.15", x = unit(-.3, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"), 
                         just = "center", gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))

# Arrange the plot and caption side by side
combined_plot_5g <- grid.arrange(
  p_5g, 
  arrangeGrob(caption_grob, nrow = 2),  # Create a layout with the caption above the legend
  ncol = 2, 
  widths = c(3, 1),  # Adjust the relative widths of the plot and the caption
  heights = c(1, 0.1)  # Adjust the relative heights of the plot and the caption
)

#adding LOESS predictions to data set 
loess_predictions_5g <- data.frame(predict(loess_15_5g , newdata = data.frame(`cDNA..` = 633:794)))
loess_predictions_5g <- loess_predictions_5g%>%rename(LOESS_5g = `predict.loess_15_5g..newdata...data.frame.cDNA.....633.794..`)%>%mutate(`cDNA..` = 633:794)

loess_predictions_13g <- data.frame(predict(loess_15_13g , newdata = data.frame(`cDNA..` = 633:794)))
loess_predictions_13g <- loess_predictions_13g%>%rename(LOESS_13g = `predict.loess_15_13g..newdata...data.frame.cDNA.....633.794..`)%>%mutate(`cDNA..` = 633:794)




###Median Donor adjusted values intered into table here POST LOESS ADJUSTMENT##########
# 1. Merge LOESS predictions (keep as before)
data_5g_13g_combined <- left_join(data_5g_13g_combined, loess_predictions_5g , by = "cDNA..")
data_5g_13g_combined <- left_join(data_5g_13g_combined, loess_predictions_13g , by = "cDNA..")

# 2. Calculate LOESS-adjusted values for each donor
data_5g_13g_combined <- data_5g_13g_combined %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_5g = LogFC_5g - LOESS_5g,
    adjusted_13g = LogFC_13g - LOESS_13g
  )

# 3. Compute scaling values using only current dataset
shared_variants_syn <- data_5g_13g_combined %>% filter(Mutation.type == "Syn")
shared_variants_non <- data_5g_13g_combined %>% filter(Mutation.type == "Non")

syn_scale_value <- mean(c(median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_5g, na.rm = TRUE), median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_13g, na.rm = TRUE)))
non_scale_value <- mean(c(median(shared_variants_non$adjusted_5g, na.rm = TRUE), median(shared_variants_non$adjusted_13g, na.rm = TRUE)))

syn_median_5g <- median(data_5g_13g_combined$adjusted_5g[data_5g_13g_combined$Mutation.type == "Syn"], na.rm = TRUE)
syn_median_13g <- median(data_5g_13g_combined$adjusted_13g[data_5g_13g_combined$Mutation.type == "Syn"], na.rm = TRUE)
non_median_5g <- median(data_5g_13g_combined$adjusted_5g[data_5g_13g_combined$Mutation.type == "Non"], na.rm = TRUE)
non_median_13g <- median(data_5g_13g_combined$adjusted_13g[data_5g_13g_combined$Mutation.type == "Non"], na.rm = TRUE)

scale_factor_5g <- (non_scale_value - syn_scale_value) / (non_median_5g - syn_median_5g)
shift_factor_5g <- syn_scale_value - scale_factor_5g * syn_median_5g

scale_factor_13g <- (non_scale_value - syn_scale_value) / (non_median_13g - syn_median_13g)
shift_factor_13g <- syn_scale_value - scale_factor_13g * syn_median_13g

# 4. Apply the transformation
data_5g_13g_combined <- data_5g_13g_combined %>%
  mutate(
    logFC_5g_adj = adjusted_5g * scale_factor_5g + shift_factor_5g,
    logFC_13g_adj = adjusted_13g * scale_factor_13g + shift_factor_13g,
    logFC_adj_avg = (logFC_5g_adj + logFC_13g_adj) / 2
  )

#######extrapolating threshold values #######################################
data_thresholdnon_syn <- data_5g_13g_nonsyn%>%select(logFC_adj_avg)
set.seed(72) # Ensure reproducibility

# Define a function to fit the GMM, classify data, and repeat the process
run_gmm_classification <- function( num_iterations = 1000) {
  # Initialize a data frame to store results
   new_point_labels <- data.frame(
    logFC_adj_avg = numeric(),
    posterior.comp.1 = numeric(),
    posterior.comp.2 = numeric(),
    label = character(),
    iteration = integer(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
   

    
  # Loop to add data points and run GMM
  for (iteration in 1:num_iterations) {
    # Add a random data point within the specified range
    new_point <- data.frame(logFC_adj_avg = runif(1, min = -2, max = -0.5))
    data <- rbind(data_thresholdnon_syn , new_point)
    
    # Fit the Gaussian mixture model with 2 components
    mixmdl <- normalmixEM(data$logFC_adj_avg, k = 2)
    posterior <- mixmdl$posterior
    
    # Define thresholds for classifying functional SNVs
    thresholds <- c(0.99, 0.01)
    
     # Classify SNVs based on posterior probabilities for the new point
    new_point_posterior <- posterior[nrow(posterior), ]
    
    # Determine the label for the new point
    new_point_label <- ifelse(
      new_point_posterior[1] > thresholds[1], 'non-functional',
      ifelse(new_point_posterior[1] < thresholds[2], 'functional', 'intermediate')
    )
    
    # Store only the new point's classification
   new_point_labels <- rbind(new_point_labels, data.frame(
      logFC_adj_avg = new_point$logFC_adj_avg,
      posterior.comp.1 = new_point_posterior[1],
      posterior.comp.2 = new_point_posterior[2],
      label = new_point_label,
      iteration = iteration
    ))

  }
return(new_point_labels)
}



# Example usage
results <- run_gmm_classification()


##############avging threshold values ###############
# Function to run the GMM classification and extract the range for "intermediate" label for each run
run_gmm_classification_and_extract_ranges <- function() {
  # Initialize an empty list to store range results
  range_results_list <- vector("list", 25)
  
  # Run the classification 100 times
  for (i in 1:25) {
    # Run the classification
    result <- run_gmm_classification()
    
    # Filter the results to get only the rows labeled "intermediate"
    intermediate_results <- result[result$label == "intermediate", ]
    
    # Check if there are any intermediate results
    if (nrow(intermediate_results) > 0) {
      # Calculate the range of values in the "intermediate" label column
      value_range <- range(intermediate_results$logFC_adj_avg, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      # If no intermediate results, set the range to NA
      value_range <- c(NA, NA)
    }
    
    # Store the range in the list
    range_results_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      Run = i,
      Min = value_range[1],
      Max = value_range[2]
    )
  }
  
  # Combine all ranges into one data frame
  combined_ranges <- do.call(rbind, range_results_list)
  
  return(combined_ranges)
}

#creating a combined column
data_3m_11m_combined <- data.frame(
  LogFC_3m = annotated_3m_1Libp$fold_change,
  LogFC_11m = annotated_11m_2Libp$fold_change, 
   LogFC_5g = annotated_5g_1Libp$fold_change,
  LogFC_13g = annotated_13g_2Libp$fold_change
)

# Calculate additional columns
data_3m_11m_combined <- data_3m_11m_combined %>%
  mutate(
    avgFC_cDNA = (LogFC_3m + LogFC_11m) / 2,
    avgFC_gDNA = (LogFC_5g + LogFC_13g) / 2,
    `(avgLogFC_cDNA)-(avgLogFC_gDNA)` = (avgFC_cDNA - avgFC_gDNA ),
    varFC_cDNA = (LogFC_3m - avgFC_cDNA)^2,
    sdFC_cDNA = sqrt(varFC_cDNA),
    `cDNA..` = annotated_3m_1Libp$`cDNA..`,
    `pro..` = annotated_3m_1Libp$`pro..`,
    Mutation.type = annotated_3m_1Libp$Mutation.type,
    ClinVar = annotated_3m_1Libp$ClinVar, 
    Mutcode = annotated_3m_1Libp$Mutcode)

#position vs Adj RNA expression

  labs(title = "gDNA Position vs Adj RNA Expression", x = " gDNA position", y = "(avgLogFC_cDNA)   -  (avgLogFC_gDNA)",color = "Mutation Type") +  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mis" = "#1f77b4", "Non" = "#e63f29", "Syn" = "#42bd0d")) +  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 772.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +  # Adjust vertical line style
  geom_vline(xintercept = 677.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +  # Adjust vertical line style

# Define a function to calculate counts for each ClinVar classification within a dataset
calculate_clinvar_summary <- function(data, category_name) {
  data %>%
    count(ClinVar) %>%
    mutate(Category = category_name)
}

# Calculate counts for each ClinVar classification in functional, intermediate, and nonfunctional datasets
functional_summary <- calculate_clinvar_summary(functional_donor_avg, "Functional")
intermediate_summary <- calculate_clinvar_summary(intermediate_donor_avg, "Intermediate")
nonfunctional_summary <- calculate_clinvar_summary(non_functional_donor_avg, "Nonfunctional")

# Combine all results into a single table
clinvar_summary <- bind_rows(functional_summary, intermediate_summary, nonfunctional_summary)

# Calculate total counts for each ClinVar classification across all datasets
total_clinvar_counts <- clinvar_summary %>%
  group_by(ClinVar) %>%
  summarize(Total_Count = sum(n))

# Merge the total counts back into the summary table and calculate percentages specific to each ClinVar classification
clinvar_summary_with_percentage <- clinvar_summary %>%
  left_join(total_clinvar_counts, by = "ClinVar") %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (n / Total_Count) * 100)

# Output the summary table with counts and percentages for each ClinVar classification across all datasets
clinvar_summary_with_percentage

# Open file for writing
file_conn <- file(output_file, "w")

# Write header
writeLines(c(
  "# Attribute file for ChimeraX",
  "attribute: avg_logFC_adj",
  "match mode: 1-to-1",
  "recipient: residues",
  ""
), file_conn)

# Write each row in the correct format
for (i in seq_len(nrow(avg_logFC))) {
  line <- sprintf("\t:%s\t%f", avg_logFC$pro[i], avg_logFC$avg_logFC_adj[i])
  writeLines(line, file_conn)
}

# Close file
close(file_conn)

# Print completion message
cat("Defattr file saved as:", output_file, "\n")
